author: Vieillot, 1819
summary: 해마다 10건이 안 되게 기록되는 길잃은새로, 8–9월에 강원 고성과 경북 포항, 부산 등 동해·남해 앞바다에서 관찰되었다. 북극권의 툰드라에서 번식하며, 여름에는 레밍과 들쥐 같은 작은 설치류를 주로 잡아먹는다. 바다에서는 물고기를 잡거나 다른 바닷새의 먹이를 빼앗으며, 번식을 마치면 남반구 바다까지 내려가 겨울을 난다.

young: 어린새는 몸 전체가 회갈색을 띠고 윗면 깃 가장자리가 연한 색이며, 아랫날개덮깃과 위·아래꼬리덮깃에 흑백 가로무늬가 뚜렷하다. 가운데 꼬리깃은 조금만 튀어나오고, 밝은 개체는 머리가 연한 담황색을 띤다.

art.subject: Long-tailed Jaeger (Stercorarius longicaudus), adult in breeding plumage, as seen at sea off Korea on spring passage (May): neat black cap; cheeks and neck white with a faint yellowish wash on the neck sides; breast white, shading into grey-brown on the belly and vent, with no breast band; upperparts cold grey-brown, contrasting with blackish flight feathers; only the outer two primary shafts white, giving a tiny white flash on the upperwing; underwing dark without a white patch; central tail feathers forming very long, thin, pointed streamers; bill short, black and hooked; dark eye; legs blue-grey with black feet.
art.pose: flying low and buoyantly over the sea, side view, the long tail streamers trailing
art.scene: open sea off the Korean east coast in May, calm blue-grey water under a pale sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, in flight seen squarely from above: long slender wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, slightly angled at the wrist, grey-brown back and wing coverts contrasting with blackish flight feathers without a white flash, black cap, very long thin central tail streamers

adult breeding, in flight seen squarely from below: long slender wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, slightly angled at the wrist, uniformly dark underwing without a white flash, black cap, whitish cheeks and neck, white breast with no band, grey belly and vent, very long thin central tail streamers, feet under the tail

adult breeding, side view sitting on the sea: small rounded head with a black cap, short black hooked bill, whitish cheeks and neck, white breast, grey-brown back, long wings, very long thin central tail streamers held raised
art.build: Slender, tern-like jaeger, the smallest and most delicate jaeger, with a body smaller than a Black-headed Gull's, a small rounded head and slim chest. Bill short and fine, much shorter than the head, with a hooked tip. Legs short, blue-grey. Long, narrow wings and a buoyant, tern-like flight. Tail wedge-shaped, the two central feathers extending into very long, flexible streamers that may equal the body length.
avoid: Do not paint a dark breast band or a large white flash at the base of the primaries; those suit Parasitic or Pomarine Jaeger.
Do not paint broad, twisted, spoon-shaped central tail feathers; that is Pomarine Jaeger (Stercorarius pomarinus).
Do not paint the upperwing uniformly dark; grey-brown coverts contrast with blackish flight feathers.
Do not give it a large, heavy gull-like bill.
